deadline.value: Submit the assistantship application and CV by January 15 to be considered in the first funding round.
deadline.quote: the Department of Geosciences has a deadline of January 15th for the given year to be considered for assistantship funding for the subsequent Fall semester

supervisor.value: Doctoral applicants must identify a dissertation mentor before admission.
supervisor.quote: All applicants for the Doctoral program must identify a mentor (dissertation supervisor) prior to acceptance into the program.

funding.value: There are more applicants than assistantship positions.
funding.quote: We often have more applications than available assistantship positions

entry_route.value: Doctoral applicants must already hold a thesis-based master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the Doctoral program are required to have completed a thesis-based Master’s degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The degree is Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, so environment is included in also_fields. The program requires a GPA of at least 3.00 and Starkville residency for coursework. No GRE or English rule is stated, so the university values apply.
name: Doctor of Philosophy in Earth and Atmospheric Sciences
